title: Telling Jokes & Humor

expressions.expr: So this guy walks into a bar and orders a drink
expressions.meaning: Então esse cara entra num bar e pede uma bebida
expressions.example: So this guy walks into a bar and orders a drink.

expressions.expr: Then the bartender says, 'We don't serve time travelers here'
expressions.meaning: Aí o barman diz: 'Não servimos viajantes do tempo aqui'
expressions.example: Then the bartender says, 'We don't serve time travelers here.'

expressions.expr: Suddenly, the punchline hits and everyone bursts out laughing
expressions.meaning: De repente, vem o desfecho e todo mundo cai na gargalhada
expressions.example: Suddenly, the punchline hits and everyone bursts out laughing.

expressions.expr: Wait for it, the timing makes the joke even funnier
expressions.meaning: Espera só, o timing torna a piada ainda mais engraçada
expressions.example: Wait for it... the timing makes the joke even funnier.

sentences: So this guy walks into a bar and orders a drink.
Then the bartender says, 'We don't serve time travelers here.'
Suddenly, the punchline hits and everyone bursts out laughing.
Wait for it... the timing makes the joke even funnier.
She has a great sense of humor.
That pun was so bad it was funny.
He always cracks jokes during meetings.
I couldn't stop laughing at his deadpan face.

grammar.title: Presente Narrativo para Contar Piadas
rules: Usamos o presente simples para narrar piadas e histórias, mesmo que sejam no passado, para dar sensação de imediatismo: So this guy walks into a bar...
Palavras de sequência como "then", "suddenly", "next" marcam a progressão da piada.
"Wait for it" cria suspense antes do punchline.
O timing (pausa antes do punchline) é tão importante quanto as palavras escolhidas.
